verdict.rationale: Ashby documents AI that scans existing candidates and matches them against job criteria, so the core matching capability exists, though it is framed around rediscovery rather than screening inbound applicants. There is no documentation of how the matching works or what safeguards apply to automated decisions. The only safeguard-related evidence is a community report that the candidate AI opt-out form never worked. missing for 10: documentation of how AI screening/matching works, documented safeguards or human-review controls for automated decisions, evidence of screening inbound applicants (not just rediscovery), independent corroboration that matching works well.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: Use AI to scan your existing candidates, match them against job criteria, and surface key signals for rediscovery.
